client.name: Summit Manufacturing Corp
client.description: Summit Manufacturing Corp is a leading producer of precision industrial components serving aerospace, automotive, and energy sectors across North America and Europe. With 2,400 employees and $1.2B annual revenue, Summit operates 8 manufacturing facilities and maintains ISO 9001, AS9100, and NADCAP certifications.
challenges: Legacy ERP system (Oracle EBS 11i) reaching end-of-life with no vendor support
Inability to support real-time production planning across 8 facilities
Manual financial consolidation taking 18 days across 3 business units
Lack of supply chain visibility causing $2M annual inventory carrying cost overrun
Compliance reporting requiring 200+ hours quarterly for SOX and AS9100 audits
objectives: Modernize ERP to cloud-native platform with 99.9% uptime SLA
Achieve real-time operational visibility across all facilities
Reduce financial close from 18 days to 5 days
Implement predictive maintenance reducing unplanned downtime by 40%
Automate compliance reporting reducing audit prep by 70%

project.title: Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Implementation
project.description: Full Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementation including Financials (GL, AP, AR, Cash Management), Supply Chain (Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing), and Project Management modules.

needs.analysis: Summit Manufacturing requires a comprehensive digital transformation of their enterprise systems. The current Oracle EBS 11i platform, implemented in 2008, cannot support the company's growth trajectory or operational complexity. Key pain points include: (1) Financial consolidation delays creating month-end bottlenecks, (2) Disconnected supply chain systems causing inventory inefficiencies, (3) Manual compliance processes consuming excessive resources, and (4) Aging infrastructure posing business continuity risks.
success_factors: Executive sponsorship from CEO and CFO with weekly engagement
Dedicated internal project team of 6 FTEs including IT Director
Clear scope boundaries with change control process
Phased rollout reducing risk (pilot facility → remaining 7)
Comprehensive change management with 200+ end users
Data migration strategy preserving 15 years historical data
risks: Resource availability during peak production seasons
Data quality issues in legacy system requiring cleansing
User adoption resistance in facilities with low digital maturity

solution.overview: Apex Digital Solutions proposes a comprehensive Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementation tailored to Summit Manufacturing's multi-facility operational model. Our solution combines standard Oracle Cloud best practices with manufacturing-specific configurations including shop-floor integration, lot traceability, and multi-entity consolidation. The engagement follows our proven 4-phase Cloud Ascend methodology with fixed-price delivery.
scope: Oracle Fusion Financials (GL, AP, AR, Cash Management, Expenses, Budgetary Control)
Oracle Supply Chain (Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing, Maintenance)
Oracle Project Management (Project Financials, Grants Management)
Integration with existing MES, WMS, CRM, and HRIS systems
Data migration from Oracle EBS 11i (15 years historical data)
Custom reporting and analytics using Oracle Analytics Cloud
Security role design for 400+ users across 8 facilities
Change management and training program for 200+ end users
deliverables: Configured and tested Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP environment
Data migration validation reports with 99.5% accuracy
Security documentation and role assignment matrix
Training materials and recorded sessions library
exclusions: Oracle Cloud software licenses (client direct agreement with Oracle)
Network infrastructure upgrades at facility sites
Organization restructuring or process redesign outside ERP scope
